integrity: Proof and integer verifier are included. The verifier checks all ambiguity coefficients in field degrees 2--5, plus the zero-shift spectrum and every derivative fiber in degree 6. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns full complex-linear Gabor operator analysis over binary Gold graphs with gcd(m,k)=1; it does not establish nonlinear pure-state phase retrieval or general non-Gold spectra. Finite enumeration supports but does not replace the infinite-degree proof. An unindexed equivalent computation is a bibliographic possibility.
title: Gold-graph Gabor tomography: an arithmetic Walsh-band transition and an APN spectral criterion
